nodes.statement: PreparationRun stores the exact Session snapshot and source selection. Publish and continuation read the persisted run and exact candidate; mismatches refuse before effects.
CandidatePrepared/v2 and ReviewRequest bind id plus attempt, request identity/revision and source digest. Event replay remains distinct from a new attempt.
Every source/evidence/lineage/selection reference to one logical path must select the same exact binding. Enforce at edit and export/preparation.
Confirmation means a ready session agrees exactly with the observed candidate package; authored hashes are not observation.
Preflight capacity before append/upsert; a full collection accepts replacement only where declared. Return domain refusal, not an uncaught bounds failure.

The current model and its generated artifacts own every Define decision. Generic byte/encoding/storage adapters contain no Define policy. Predecessor replay is explicitly unsupported or separately converted; no silent rebase.
Use the shared original-file binding including digest_kind, or an exact explicit representation map. Selected canonical-entry digests remain distinct from original-file digests.
